ruleDefinitions.name: OSACompile Run-Only Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential suspicious run-only executions compiled using OSACompile

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*osacompile.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-x\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-e\\ .*"))
